headline: Approved a partial certificate of compliance for 78 Oakbrook Drive, East Longmeadow, needed to sell the property.
summary: The commission issued a partial certificate of compliance for 78 Oakbrook Drive in East Longmeadow. Part of the larger project lies outside the commission's jurisdiction. The meeting also discussed sewer pipe work on Jamaica Street, which began without notice to the commission; no vote was taken on it.
decisions: Approved a partial certificate of compliance for 78 Oakbrook Drive, East Longmeadow, by roll call vote.
discussion: Jamaica Street sewer work: Work started without notice to the commission. Speakers agreed that plans and specs should be sent for review before any work starts, and that silt fence must be installed in the ground.
Split parcels: The house sits on both sides of the town line. Discussion noted that a child's school could depend on which side of the house the bedroom is on.

decision_evidence.quote: I'll make a motion to issue a partial certificate of compliance for uh 78 Oakbrook Drive, East Longmeadow. I'll second it. Commissioner Gonzales? Yes. Commissioner Almeyda? Yes. Commissioner Jones? Yes, yes. All right, and Commissioner Bongiorno? Yes.

decision_titles: Partial certificate of compliance for 78 Oakbrook Drive, East Longmeadow
